params._about: Solo-tuned AI stats for the Skyglass treasure hunts (engine/hunts.ts). Keys are live AI ids; pools = poolsMultiplier, rows = innate +100% damage-given rows (each capped at 100 by the engine, rows multiply), stats = statsMultiplier where changed from live. Crown Archivist (Archive alarm guard) and the Called to the Archive summon (Crown Stonebound: echoHp, echoPower) per RUL-2026-10-28-013.
params._final_pass: fable/skyglass-final-sim: Watch Captain 2/4 -> 2.5/1 + 10% givenDown (the phase-1 duel killed a solo player by round 3-9: 7/40); Foundry Warden 2.5/1 -> 3.5/1 (97.5% -> target 80%); Cache Sentinel 3/3 -> 3/4 (RUL-2026-10-28-021: boss ~20% HP); echoPower 60 -> 40 (RUL-2026-10-28-026 item 3).

variants.L100: director's endgame party member (2026-10-28): level-100 JONIN, stats at the JONIN caps, full Kitsune armour set (6 captured pieces, worn through the engine's item path), 9 PvE jutsu at the level cap 25, Fire/Wind elements
variants.L100noarmor: reference: the average build without the Kitsune set
variants.L50: easier-version average: level-50 CHUNIN, level-50 stat budget (scaleUserStats 'player') spread evenly, calcHP/CP/SP(50) = 2,550 pools, Chunin kit at jutsu level 15, no gear

fs-crate-swing.note: Swings a looted crate. The same steady hit every time.

fs-cutlass-slash.note: A looter's cutlass. The same hard cut every time.

fs-pocket-a-ration.note: Once a fight, at half health, he eats a pocketed ration and can't fall this round.

fs-hand-out-a-ration.note: Feeds one looter beside him: it can't fall this round and heals a little.

fs-count-out-a-ration.note: Alone, he counts out a ration for himself. He eats it next turn.

fs-eat-a-ration.note: Eats the ration he counted out: he can't fall this round and heals a little.

fs-count-the-stores.note: A slow, heavy hit. Each count makes the next few hit harder.

fs-stack-the-crates.note: Stacks looted crates into a wall in front of the crew.

fs-open-the-stores.note: Opens the stores: every looter around him is fed this round.

fs-up-from-the-hold.note: Calls a deckhand up from the hold.

fs-looting-deckhand.note: beach raider + fight 1/3 looter (Deck Warden statline); pools 1.3, statsMultiplier 1, +100% damage taken; opponent_scaled_to_user
